title: Migrate Five Probes from Gruyere Auth Pattern to Auth Discoverer
goal: Refactor info_disclosure_probe, param_pollution_probe, stored_xss_probe, cookie_tamper_probe, and file_upload_probe to call auth_discoverer (cache -> fingerprint -> AI recipe -> verify) instead of their hardcoded saveprofile?action=new pattern. Validate that all five produce non-zero findings on at least 2 non-Gruyere targets and continue to find Gruyere R1/R2/R3/R5/R7/R10/R15/R20 on Gruyere.
scope: Replace each probe's local _register_as_author / _register_with_delimiter logic with a call to auth_discoverer.acquire_session(target, scope_allowlist). Keep the probe's vulnerability-specific testing logic. Add an empirical generality test that runs each probe against Gruyere + juice-shop + demo.testfire.net + testasp.vulnweb.com and records findings_count per (probe, target).
generation_reason: Empirical test on 2026-05-15 confirmed these 5 probes silently no-op on non-Gruyere targets due to hardcoded saveprofile auth pattern. This is the visible payoff of phase 2: same probes now work on diverse stacks.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Migrate ONLY the named 5 probes. Do NOT touch xss_proof, smart_web_probe, or other runners.
constraints.no_regression_gruyere: Each migrated probe MUST still find on Gruyere the vulnerability classes it found before migration (R1/R2/R3/R5/R7/R10/R15/R20 as applicable).
constraints.test_targets_required: Probes must be validated against at least Gruyere + 2 of {juice-shop.herokuapp.com, demo.testfire.net, testasp.vulnweb.com}. Where a target lacks the vulnerability class, 0 findings is acceptable, but the probe MUST reach the testing stage (attempts > 0).

success_criteria: Each of the 5 probes imports auth_discoverer and removes its local registration helper.
Each probe's findings on Gruyere remain at parity with pre-migration findings.
Each probe makes at least 1 attempt on each of the 4 test targets (attempts > 0 in trace, even if 0 findings).
Generality test script runs all 5 probes against all 4 targets in CI/integration and emits a matrix.
AGENT_SYSTEM_MAP.md section 3 is updated to move these 5 probes from Gruyere-specific to Verified-generic.

required_checks: .venv/bin/ruff check workers/runners/info_disclosure_probe workers/runners/param_pollution_probe workers/runners/stored_xss_probe workers/runners/cookie_tamper_probe workers/runners/file_upload_probe
acceptance_criteria: Generality matrix shows attempts > 0 for at least 3 non-Gruyere targets per probe.
Gruyere parity: each probe finds the same vulnerability classes it did before migration.
No Gruyere-specific endpoint pattern remains hardcoded in any of the 5 probes.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.

out_of_scope: Non-form auth flows (OAuth, SAML, JWT-only API auth).
